modules.name: Shoal
modules.description: 8-track generative melody sequencer. Melodies grown from seeds, never stored.

modules.name: Shoal Expander
modules.description: 12 CV inputs to modulate any track; chainable; sits either side of Shoal.

modules.name: Shoal Outs
modules.description: Per-track Currents (seeded drift CV) and end-of-sequence triggers; sits either side of Shoal.

modules.name: Fluke
modules.description: Random voltages, free until you catch one you like. Eight tracks of random CV that become loops when you catch them.

modules.name: Haar
modules.description: Lush algorithmic stereo reverb. Cold sea fog: smeared, blooming, dark on top.

modules.name: Wake
modules.description: Ambient delay. Echoes trail behind the sound like a ship's wake, never quite the same way twice.

modules.name: Harbour
modules.description: A four-channel stereo mixer with two send and return loops, that can breathe on its own.
